entities.name: Annica Åhlén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Annica Gunilla Åhlén is a retired Swedish ice hockey goaltender. Åhlén first represented Team Sweden internationally at the 1990 IIHF Women's World Championship. In total, she has played in 16 world championships games, with a record of 7 wins, 8 losses and 1 tie. Åhlén played for Sweden at the 1998 and 2002 Winter Olympics, capturing a bronze medal in 2002.
